BiblicalUsage: Horem is a fenced city in Naphtali, named once in the list of the tribe's strong cities. It stands among the fortified towns given to Naphtali, one of the walls that guarded the northern border of the land.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the fenced cities of Naphtali were God's provision for a border tribe, and He gives walls to those who live nearest the enemy.
